title.narrative: Support to the semi-industrial processing of sugar cane - Appui à la transformation semi-industrielle de la canne à sucre à Madagascar

description.narrative: The project is implemented in close collaboration with the Malagasy Center of the Sugar and Sugar Cane, with the overall objective to contribute to poverty reduction in rural areas through a sustainable and inclusive development of the sugar cane value chain. The expected result is to improve the productivity of the semi-industrial sugar cane sector and to add value to products as a mean to generate more income, integrating small scale independent producers. The project applies a holistic approach to address the bottlenecks facing the different actors involved in the supply chain of sugar cane, from the production level, through the processing, storage, until it reaches the marketing stage. The project provides technical assistance and capacity building to the local stakeholders, using a partnership with private enterprises as a mean to ensure sustainability.
